system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes in dressing-gown with pipe, seated by the upper window beside Dr. Watson in tweed, both watching from the Crown Inn bedroom","action":"Holmes turns from the window toward Watson as they sit in gathering dark, the window showing the avenue gate and a lamp just kindled among the trees","setting":"Upper-floor bedroom and sitting-room of the Crown Inn, Surrey village; coal fire low, oil lamp unlit or dim; view across to the manor's inhabited wing","secondaryElements":"Distant lit window glowing through autumn trees; iron avenue gate and gravel approach faintly visible; a violin case resting by the wall; pipe smoke drifting","mood":"Restrained suspense, intimate and dry, quiet tension before danger","timeOfDay":"Dusk fading into full night, late autumn","composition":"Interior medium shot framed by the window, Holmes and Watson in profile, the distant manor light small in the darkened glass at upper centre"}
